mappings.reason: Tab. 43.3 is gas burnt as process fuel, so a combustion dataset is needed. 'Heat, natural gas, at industrial furnace 1MW' is the dataset every ecoinvent-v2 organic-chemical unit process in BAFU uses for exactly this (2.0 MJ of it appears in Cumene, Ethyl benzene, Bisphenol A, Phosgene and Aniline), which beats the near-identical 'Natural gas, burned in industrial furnace 1MW' on consistency with the family; 'xxx Heat ... low-NOx' is an xx-marked legacy dataset and 'District heat, at consumer' is the wrong delivery form.

'Dust (SPM)' is a single unspeciated particulate figure; of the candidates only the particle flows are the right substance, and PM10 is the ecoinvent/EF convention for an unspeciated dust figure - it beats 'Particles (PM0.2)', which would claim a fineness the report does not state, and 'Particulates, unspecified' in bafu-2026-residual, which has no EF counterpart and would add a flow the target does not carry.

SOx reported as one figure is inventoried as SO2 in ecoinvent and EF 3.1, and the target's own vector carries Sulfur Dioxide, not Sulfur Oxides; the emissions-to-air compartment beats the soil and water entries of the same flow.
The methane comes from natural gas, so the fossil flow, not the biogenic one; 'Methanethiol' and 'Methanesulfonic Acid' are different substances that only match the search string.
NOx as a sum is the 'Nitrogen Oxides' flow; 'Nitrogen Dioxide' would claim a speciation the report does not give and 'Nitrogen' is the element.
